text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 4, "unit": "rows", "kind": "count", "span": "4 rows of seats"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 18, "unit": "seats", "kind": "count", "span": "18 seats in each row"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 4, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "One-fourth of the seats were occupied by the administrators"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 0.3333333333333333, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "One-third of the remaining seats were occupied by the parents"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "total seats in the auditorium"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s1", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "seats taken by administrators, one fourth of the total"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s1", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "seats remaining after the administrators"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s3", "q4"], "out": "s4", "note": "seats taken by parents, one third of the remainder"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s3", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "the rest of the remaining seats hold the students"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "the number of students in the school auditorium"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 1, "reason": "the '1' of 'One-fourth' and 'One-third' belongs to the fraction wording; the fractions themselves are what the plan uses"}]}
